title: Settlement of an Allowed Claim on a Pass and Trip Protection Plan
content:
An allowed claim on a Pass and Trip Protection plan is settled by paying it out on the plan and drawing the
money down from the cover the plan carries for the season. The household sees the money reach them by the
route the payout goes, and the cover left on the plan for the rest of the season falls by the amount paid, the
cover left being the cover loaded onto the plan less every payout booked against it.

What a claim pays is worked out only after the value the plan carries as covered stands at the price the
covered holding's own record shows, since what is paid is measured against the value the plan covers.

**How the settlement is booked.** The tool `settle_protection_claim_ed51c2df` is unlocked and then called by
the desk. One call books a single payout entry on that plan's protection account for the amount given, tied to
the holding the cover is written over, to what the household claimed on, and to the entry recording the paper
the payout was assessed from.

**What is passed to it.**

- `protection_plan_id` — the reference number of the protection plan the payout is booked on, as the
  protection plan lookup returns it.
- `covered_holding_id` — the reference number of the holding the plan is written over and the claim was made
  about, read from the covered holding field of that plan.
- `related_event_id` — the reference number of the single protection account entry the payout is assessed
  from, read from the protection account entries of that plan.
- `claim_reason` — what the household claimed on, exactly one of: `medical_injury` where the insured was hurt
  and cannot ski; `medical_illness` where the insured fell ill and cannot ski; `job_loss` where the household
  lost the employment it was relying on; `relocation` where the household has moved permanently away from the
  region; `mountain_closure` where the mountain itself was shut; `travel_disruption` where the journey to the
  mountain was lost; `bereavement` where a death in the household ended the season; `none` where the entry is
  tied to no claim at all.
- `payout_method` — how the money reaches the household, exactly one of: `resort_credit` where it is placed on
  the household account to spend with the collective; `original_payment_method` where it goes back to the card
  or bank the premium was taken from; `bank_transfer` where it is sent to the household's own bank account;
  `none` where the entry moves no money to the household.
- `payout_amount_usd` — the money paid out on this claim, in USD, to 2 decimal places as a plain number such
  as 1234.56 with no currency symbol and no thousands separator; it is booked to the cent exactly as passed.

**What comes back.** A single line of confirmation text naming the new protection account entry reference, the
protection plan it was booked on, the amount paid out in USD to the cent and the route it went by. The line
beginning with the word Paid is the receipt that the payout was booked; any other wording means nothing was
booked.
